params.body:
`/internal/commitments` (from #244) was on neither of the two lists that let a signed machine route through:

- **The pre-launch cover** (`PreLaunch::ALWAYS_OPEN`). An unsigned GET on gentells.com returns the "Coming soon" page with a 200. The Observatory read that as an empty answer, so its Deliveries page said "Nothing is due" and listed no categories under Category owners.
- **The CSRF check** (`bootstrap/app.php`). A signed POST that moves a delivery (taken up, delivered) would have been refused with a 419.

Both lists now hold `internal/commitments` and `internal/commitments/*`, the same way they hold `internal/accounts`.

`PreLaunchTest::test_every_internal_route_gets_past_the_cover_and_the_csrf_check` walks every route under `internal/`, with the cover on. Each route must get past the cover, and each POST must be excluded from the CSRF check. A new internal route that misses either list now fails the suite. Without this fix, the test fails on `GET /internal/commitments`.

Tests: the full suite passes (556 tests) apart from BuildStampTest, which needs a real checkout. Pint is clean on the changed files.
params.title: Let the Observatory past the cover to the deliveries routes
